frozen_metrics.spectral_cell_classification: For every module x rank x prompt x replica x checkpoint cell, apply the v2 relative spectral floor and boundary-gap rule to the sealed singular spectrum.
frozen_metrics.eligible_family: All 96 local cells pass and all four registered consensus fits satisfy the same boundary-gap rule.
frozen_metrics.heldout_cell_retention: For each registered cross-fit direction and evaluation cell, lambda_min(V_fit^T P_cell V_fit). The four evaluation quadrants form an exact partition of the 96 cells.
frozen_metrics.certification_fragility_curve: Sort the 96 held-out cell retentions ascending and report the remaining minimum after excluding exactly x worst cells for x=0,...,95. Crossing requires a strict margin above the unchanged familywise null threshold.
frozen_metrics.axis_decomposition: Balanced orthogonal main-effect sums of squares for prompt, replica, and checkpoint on the 96 cell retentions; residual contains interactions and unexplained variation.
frozen_metrics.leave_one_level_out: Remove one complete prompt, replica, or checkpoint level from evaluation only and recompute the remaining minimum. Descriptive only; it cannot alter the registered gate.

diagnostic_thresholds.single_axis_level_rescue: At least one leave-one-level-out remaining floor is strictly above the unchanged null threshold.

decision_rules.sparse_failure: At most 10% of the 96 cell retentions are at or below the registered null.
decision_rules.diffuse_failure: More than 10% of the 96 cell retentions are at or below the registered null.
decision_rules.axis_dominant: One balanced main effect explains at least 50% of total retention sum of squares.
decision_rules.mixed_or_interaction: No registered main effect explains at least 50% of total retention sum of squares.
decision_rules.authorization: No diagnostic result authorizes outcomes, finite-norm edits, signed rewards, or threshold relaxation.

claim_boundary: This audit localizes where the already-failed target-blind identity certificate breaks. Quantile, exclusion, energy, and axis results are diagnostic and cannot replace the preregistered minimum-retention decision. They do not measure behavioral control loss or self-improvement risk directly.
